notes: The XML isn't parsed by a real XML library at all -- `listVersionPairs` and `latestStableVersion` both hand-scan the raw text for literal `<version>`/`</version>` substrings (lines 52-56), collecting everything between them regardless of surrounding structure. "Stable" is then just `!version.contains("-")` (line 57) -- the one real pre-release entry in this corpus, "20.2.12-beta", is dropped by that check alone; there is no separate channel field to consult, unlike Paper's STABLE/BETA/ALPHA. Every remaining entry is listed (not just the newest build per MC version) because modpacks pin exact NeoForge builds.
